description: Hand a mission off to the AI agent team. Omit startAt for the default full run (planner first); pass startAt='builder' with a plan to skip straight to coding; pass startAt='reviewer' or startAt='qa' with an existing prNumber to hand off an existing build. Requires the missions:run token scope.

agents.description: Per-role harness/model override for THIS mission only; overrides ship.yml without changing it

issueId.description: The mission's issue id: a Linear key or a GitHub Issues id, e.g. SHIP-244 or WEB-42

prNumber.description: Existing open PR number, required for startAt='reviewer' or startAt='qa'

projectId.description: Project id the mission belongs to

startAt.description: Pipeline stage to enter at; omit for the default full run starting at the planner

name: start_mission
title: Start a mission
